THE PAGE IS A PHOTOGRAPH -- pdfplumber returns 1 word and the page holds one image at 223 dpi -- AND IT IS LANDSCAPE, so it was rotated into its own one-page PDF first and the crops aimed at coordinates that mean what they look like. THE PRINTED HEADER, verbatim, column by column: `ART #/YR | PURPOSE | APPROPRIATED FORWARD | EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/ TRANSFERRED | BALANCE`, with a narrow unheaded column between APPROPRIATED FORWARD and EXPENDED that carries the marker `fwd`. The page's own legend, at its foot: `fwd - forward from FY 16`, `ATM - Annual Town Meeting`, `STM - Special Town Meeting`. Projects are grouped under italic programme headings FY14 / FY15 / FY16 / FY17 Capital Program; the article and year in ART #/YR is what a resident uses to find the vote that authorised the project. 36 projects. ALL THREE COLUMNS TIE TO THE PRINTED GRAND TOTAL TO THE CENT: APPROPRIATED FORWARD $12,169,172.27, EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/TRANSFERRED $3,583,457.59, BALANCE $8,585,714.68 -- and the Grand Total row's own identity closes, 12,169,172.27 - 3,583,457.59 = 8,585,714.68. All 36 project rows satisfy APPROPRIATED FORWARD minus EXPENDED/ENCUMBERED/TRANSFERRED equals BALANCE, to the cent. A single wrong digit anywhere would break one of those and the column it sits in. ONE PROJECT PRINTS ITS COLUMN ON TWO LINES AND THE PAGE'S OWN ARITHMETIC ESTABLISHES THAT IT IS ONE ROW. `Development of Cemeteries` (art 08/02 ATM) prints $35,000.00 on the line above and ($9,210.37) marked `fwd` on its own line, against one EXPENDED figure $26,402.59 and one BALANCE ($612.96): 35,000.00 - 9,210.37 - 26,402.59 = -612.96 exactly, which is what says the two lines are the appropriation and its carry-forward rather than two projects. The merged figure $25,789.63 is recorded as that project's APPROPRIATED FORWARD and BOTH PRINTED LINES ARE KEPT VERBATIM BESIDE IT as separate rows, so nothing is quoted that the page does not print. A NEGATIVE IN THE EXPENDED COLUMN IS PRINTED IN PARENTHESES and means a credit back to the project -- five rows carry one, and each of them closes. A blank EXPENDED cell is left blank by the page and is not recorded as a zero.
